source_text: Nihil ergo nunc damnationis est his qui sunt in Christo Iesu. Lex enim Spiritus vitae in Christo Iesu liberavit me a lege peccati et mortis.
thought_title: No condemnation for those in Christ
orientation: Paul is speaking, concluding his account of the inner conflict between the law of the mind and the law of sin by declaring freedom from condemnation for those in Christ Jesus.
pass_a_gloss: Nothing therefore now of condemnation is [to] these who are in Christ Jesus. [The] law for of [the] Spirit of life in Christ Jesus freed me from [the] law of sin and of death.

choices.english: Therefore there is now no condemnation
choices.why: Keeps the strong negation 'nihil...damnationis' as 'no condemnation' and preserves 'ergo' as 'therefore' and 'nunc' as 'now' to mark the transition from the previous struggle.
rejected: So then there is no sentence of doom
Nothing of condemnation therefore now exists

choices.term: his qui sunt in Christo Iesu
choices.english: for those who are in Christ Jesus
choices.why: Renders the dative of possession 'his' as 'for those' and keeps the prepositional phrase 'in Christo Iesu' as 'in Christ Jesus' to preserve the spatial metaphor of union with Christ.
rejected: to the ones in Christ Jesus
for them that are in Christ Jesus

choices.english: For the law of the Spirit of life
choices.why: Keeps 'lex' as 'the law' per glossary, 'Spiritus' as 'the Spirit' per glossary, and the genitive chain 'Spiritus vitae' as 'of the Spirit of life' to show the Spirit as source of life.
rejected: For the law of the life-giving Spirit
For the law of the Spirit that gives life

choices.term: liberavit me a lege peccati et mortis
choices.english: has freed me from the law of sin and death
choices.why: Renders the perfect 'liberavit' as 'has freed' to show completed action with present result, and keeps 'a lege' as 'from the law' with the genitives 'peccati et mortis' as 'of sin and death'.
rejected: set me free from the law of sin and death
freed me from sin's law and death's law

bible_refs.note: Nihil ergo nunc damnationis est his qui sunt in Christo Iesu. Lex enim Spiritus vitae in Christo Iesu liberavit me a lege peccati et mortis.

pass_b_english: Therefore there is now no condemnation for those who are in Christ Jesus (Romans 8:1). For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus has freed me from the law of sin and death (Romans 8:2).
